newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends down on unimpressive export data.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends down on unimpressive export data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS

PALM OIL FUTURES - Ended lower on a lack of clear direction and technical selling, which emerged when the support level of 1,190 was broken. June 1-25 export estimates by SGS did not excite traders who said they were expecting the same or slighty higher numbers. Egypt's purchase of 25,000 tonnes of stearin and palm oil also did not move trade.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Easier with interest on nearby CPOs and products.
Traders said the figure was within the expectations of most players and slightly below the estimates of some others.
"There's nothing fantastic about the figure, it's been factored in," said one trader.
Dealers said the market opened lower, following a bearish overnight market in Chicago soyoil, and fell steadily, with the September contract breaking the 1,190 level.
"The Egypt purchase had also been factored in, even before the market opened," said another trader. "In fact, we expected them to buy 10,000 tonnes of palm stearin, not 7,000 tonnes."
At the close, September futures was down 10 ringgit to 1,188 ringgit ($471.24) a tonne. Traders said the new support level for the contract was 1,180 while resistance was at 1,200.
On the physicals side, July (south) crude palm oil saw offers at 1,227.50 ringgit against bids at 1,220 after trading from 1,230 to 1,225.
July (central) saw offers at 1,212.50 versus bids at 1,207.50 and trades of 1,217.50 and 1,210.
Aug (south) was offered at 1,225 against bids at 1,220 and trades at 1,227.50 to 1,225. Aug (central) saw offers at 1,210 and bids at 1,205 with trades at 1,217.50 to 1,210.
In refined products, July RBD palm oil was offered at $515 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Aug at $512.50, Sept at $512.50 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $510.
Last-half July RBD palm olein saw offers at $555, Aug/Sept at $550 and Oct/Nov/Dec at 550. First seven days of July was traded at $560 and $557.50.
July RBD palm stearin was offered at $397.50 and Aug/Sept at $390, while July/Aug/Sept palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $290.
